## What's new

The first release of NotchPC: a smart notch for the top of your Windows screen.

- **Music and lyrics** from any player in Windows' media controls, with seeking and synced lyrics
- **Desktop widgets:** focus timer, weather, calendar, PC stats and Twitch chat
- **Clipboard history** (encrypted), a file shelf and one-click screenshots
- **Notifications** pop out of the notch with a sound and a glow; click one to open its app
- **Game overlay** with FPS, CPU / GPU load and temperature, RAM and the time
- **Phone remote:** touchpad, keyboard, music, slides and power from your phone (scan a QR code)
- **Quick settings and a per-app volume mixer**, plus a web panel under the notch

Download `NotchPC-0.1.0-Setup.exe` below, run it and click **Install** (no admin rights, nothing else to install).
Windows may warn once because the installer isn't signed yet: **More info** → **Run anyway**.
